name: trivial-skips-the-plan
why: A one-line change must not earn a plan, an approval loop and a slice.
prompt: /davinci:build There is a typo in the page heading. It says "Plumbline Studioo" and should say "Plumbline Studio". Fix it.

expect.why: the typo was not actually fixed, so nothing else here means anything
a one-line change earned a written plan — the ceremony costs more than the change
a trivial change opened a slice journal it will never use
the user was asked to approve a plan for a typo
no brief was written, so nothing recorded what was asked for
